newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Pasminco says Elura mining suspended.
newsitem.headline: Pasminco says Elura mining suspended.

text.p: Pasminco Ltd said on Wednesday that mining at its Elura lead-zinc mine in New South Wales was suspended as a precautionary measure on Wednesday following pillar damage caused by blasting.

"The New South Wales Department of Minerals Resources inspector has been notified and is helping mine management and workforce representatives to assess the stability of the damaged pillar," Pasminco said.
"The assessment is likely to take 48 hours," it said.
"Normal operations will not resume until management is certain that the mine can be opened," the company said.
In the nine months to March 31, the Elura mine produced 104,404 tonnes of zinc concentrates and 67,842 tonnes of lead concentrates from 826,451 tonnes of ore.
